brief: Turn the index About band into its own /about page, "creative like Awwwards".
diversification: INVERTED (CLAUDE.md is the locked system). Macrostructure differs from the index and /works; theme deliberately identical.
brief_reading: Read "Awwwards" as "as well made as those pages", not as their vocabulary — WebGL, accent colour, cards, award badges and invented metrics are all on this repo REJECTED list, and one such build was already torn down here in a day.
research: Agent read 7 well-regarded about pages. Findings applied: portrait is never a hero (3 of 7 have none); personal pages run 2.3-3.1x largest-over-body, sales pages 5-10x; length correlates inversely with reading as a person; every anti-pattern found was already banned here.
caught: Two real bugs. `.st-wash` on a bare div is permanent invisibility (only `Reveal` sets data-in), and a two-column layout left ~600px of the right third empty at 1440.
measurement_trap: Playwright fullPage screenshots resize the viewport, which re-splits every `Lines` and parks it for a frame — the capture shows paragraphs missing that are actually fine.

revision.change: Colophon moved off the index and onto /about (the owner called it redundant under the work list). Index is now two bands: the name with contact, and the work.
revision.constraint: It could not simply be deleted — the Font Awesome CC BY 4.0 attribution lives in it. Tabler (react-icons/tb, MIT) remains the one-line escape if the attribution should go.
revision.verification:
Independent agent pass at 7 widths. Three findings, all fixed: a

nested inside an

(Lines gained an as="h1" option so the statement IS the heading); .st-statement .st-line missing pointer-events:none despite a 16.14px overlap between adjacent line masks; and the service/stack lists having no programmatic tie to their labels (now aria-labelledby).
revision.measurement_traps: Two more. Any viewport width change replays every reveal (Lines re-split parks the block), so a fullPage screenshot photographs a page mid-reset. And innerText inserts a break between block-level split lines, so a regex across one fails — squash whitespace first.

brief: Homepage hero read as empty. Folded the Contact section up into it; masthead <h1> untouched.
diversification: INVERTED. CLAUDE.md is this project design.md in all but filename, so consistency wins over rotation — no theme swap, no macrostructure rotation.
diagnosis: Not short of content, short of balance: the fitted masthead ends on the right margin and the intro carried md:ml-auto, so both heavy objects finished against the same edge. Dead rectangle 810x228 lower-left at 1440x900, 1195x187 at 1920.
removed: Contact.tsx — the band at the foot. Its colophon survives as Colophon.tsx.
verified: preloader handover bit-identical (dTop/dLeft/dHeight all 0) at 320/768/1440/1920; no two-line clickable and no h-overflow at 10 widths; 13/13 masked rows arrive ~50ms apart; reduce 4 vs 76 positions; contrast 0 failures with control 0->1->0.

revision.change: Address removed from the opening (it was on the first screen twice); the six contact links became brand marks instead of words.
revision.library: Font Awesome 6 Brands via react-icons. Simple Icons lacks linkedin and codepen (both brands requested removal); Lucide brand icons are deprecated outlines and its `x` is the close cross, which would have drawn a dismiss button beside a link to x.com.
revision.licence: Font Awesome Free is CC BY 4.0 — attributed in the colophon. Tabler (react-icons/tb) is the MIT fallback covering the same six, outline rather than solid.
revision.cost: +6,851 bytes of client JS, measured before and after.
revision.caught: Tailwind `m-0` beside `.st-icon-row` beat the primitive’s negative margin — utilities are layered after components — and the row sat 7.5px inside the margin at every width.

revision2.change: The two link groups ('code' and 'elsewhere') merged into one called 'social', and the hardcoded 'contact' heading went with them — the first group's label is the region heading now.
revision2.where: Merged in the site-settings global, not flattened in the component: the grouping is content, and a view that disagreed with the admin would make the admin a lie.
revision2.open: Vocabulary: the corner nav says 'contact' and the region it reaches is named 'social'. Honest that way round — the block holds no address — but one string in Corners.tsx if it should match.

revision3.change: Dropped the CodePen link (CMS content), then dropped the corner nav's 'contact' mark.
revision3.why: The mark stopped earning its place in two steps: contact moved into the opening, so it scrolled the reader back toward the top of the page they had just started on; then the address left the block for the corner above it, so what the mark reached was a row named 'social'. A mark that says one word and arrives somewhere named another is worse than no mark.
revision3.kept: The #contact id stays on the block — nothing points at it, but it is a stable anchor for a link written elsewhere.
revision3.nav: Three marks now: work, all work, about.

note: Torn down the same day. This was a brand-preserving `redesign`, so it kept the near-black ground, the single cyan accent, the hairline rules, the tracked-out all-caps eyebrows and the monospace labels — close to a complete list of the frontend-design skill's named tells. The owner read the result as unchanged, and was right to.
